title: tsconfig include and rootDir exclude a directory the app imports
summary: include and rootDir cover only src/app while the entry point imports ../lib/catalog.js, so the compiler refuses the build with TS6059. Widening the scope also moves the emitted entry point, which package.json has to follow.

checks: the project compiles with both source directories in scope
package.json declares an entry point that exists
describeCatalog sums the catalog through the entry point
the shared library is still a separate module
